Element en
Name **Articles
Synonym
Beschreibung **Articles are sales products in a specific, predefined version / variant. Articles are the things that go to the customer, as opposed to articles from purchasing and production.

Has article number and is uniquely identifiable by it

Articles can differ, for example, in (Triac ST): country, network (industrial network/home network), heating capacity, heating pipe type, mains cable...
Most ERP articles also have a photo stored for easier communication within the company

An item that exists exclusively as a purchase item is referred to as a third party item.


Examples:
141.227
Triac ST 230V/1600W/socket nozzle/EU plug

Comments PAZ and WIM:

What about the following devices?

Example
- Minifloor:
○ Drive Unit
○ Triac (becomes an accessory)
Set:
- MINOR (can be used independently as a blower or with the LABOR)
- Diode PID / Diode S (can also be used with ROBUST)

Examples:
Welding nozzles, guide rod, hand pressure roller, rollers, nozzles, glue from service/repair department


External consumable (former consumable material) (subtype of accessories? Does it have other subtypes?)

Group of sales products that can be used with Leister articles and are either used once only or show a high level of wear during use.

Examples: Welding wires, spare blades
